A '''stained glass pane''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Stonecutter]] recipes for the 16 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Stained Glass Pane}} for everything else.
